overall_reason: A deploy list ('Checkout redesign', 'Search speedup', 'Pricing copy') set so small that the working object fills a third of its own stage.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE is weak (the list is set at about 10 to 11 px inside a mostly empty grey stage) and the failed deploy is marked only by a small red icon; T-RIVAL-NAME holds.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the card's text is about 10 to 11 px and the card occupies roughly the middle third of the grey stage, with large empty bands above and below.
findings.before: A small, compressed list in a large empty stage.
findings.after: Set the rows at a readable body size and let the card fill the stage.
findings.why: The working object is the smallest thing in the frame.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the failed deploy shows only a small red circle icon and '1h ago'; no word says it failed.
findings.before: Failure shown by a small icon only.
findings.after: Add a status word ('Failed') next to the icon.
findings.why: The one row that needs action is the easiest to miss.

strengths: One dark 'Deploy' action and per-row status icons: the content is right for the task.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
